name: opentitan-rv-core-ibex
description: OpenTitan integration package for the Ibex RV32IMC RISC-V CPU. Contains rv_core_ibex_pkg.sv with SoC-level configuration types. The actual Ibex core RTL is in the separate ibex-core (vyges-ip/ibex) repository. Used by soc-generator for CPU metadata resolution.

architecture.notes: Integration package only. Ibex core RTL (ibex_top, ibex_core, pipeline stages) is in vyges-ip/ibex. This package provides SoC-level types for OpenTitan integration.

dependencies.name: ibex-core
dependencies.description: Full Ibex RV32IMC RTL (31 files, ~15K lines)

trust.notes: Ibex is silicon-proven in OpenTitan Earl Grey + FPGA-validated in edge-sensor-soc Arty A7.
